versions.changelog: Stop one-time-code fields crashing the keyboard without an App Group. Publish build-numbered IPAs as GitHub releases with changelogs. Fix missed keypresses, ghost letters and the symbols toggle. Show active VaultBridge TOTP codes in Aukkhor. Restore Aukkhor's private Keychain group. Keep VaultBridge password Keychain private. Keep VaultBridge password Keychain private. Keep VaultBridge password Keychain private. Read temporary OTP from isolated shared app group. Make the native iOS symbol page the default number layout. Fix native symbol page and show VaultBridge OTP suggestions. Add VaultBridge OTP handoff and native symbol layout. feat(keyboard): offer explicit OTP clipboard paste and native AutoFill handoff. ci(release): ship audited Aukkhor IPAs despite simulator test failures. fix(ios): keep transparent keyboard touch plate active and rescue early finger rolls. chore(ios): publish multitouch hotfix [publish-unverified]. fix(keyboard): receive simultaneous touches across shared input router. Offer selectable keyboard haptics and documented vibration fallback [native-tests]. Route keyboard touch-downs at root without duplicate inserts; rearm Taptic feedback [native-tests]. Recover fast finger-roll letter transitions and request edge gesture deferral [native-tests]. Fix root touch receiver Swift type lookup [native-tests]. Test root key routing and opt-in monitor lifecycle [native-tests]. Trace touch-downs at keyboard root separately from key router [native-tests]. Route root keyboard hits to the live key host [native-tests]. Fix keyboard touch report copy feedback and add insert-text fallback [native-tests].
